subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or part of a broader non-message event contract?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the permanent hook names, payload shape, enrichment model, and cross-channel scope are public plugin API choices automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Adopt Generic Reaction Hooks
options.body: Add observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks with a portable payload and wire Discord first without changing reaction wake or agent-turn behavior.

options.title: Defer To Broader Event API
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100447 as the API design umbrella and keep this issue as the Discord acceptance case.

options.title: Ship Discord-Only Hook
options.body: Expose a narrowly scoped Discord reaction hook sooner, accepting a later compatibility pass if the generic channel event API differs.

recommendation.title: Adopt Generic Reaction Hooks
recommendation.body: Add observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks with a portable payload and wire Discord first without changing reaction wake or agent-turn behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The request primarily changes the plugin hook contract, and git history points to vincentkoc for recent hook contract work.
